label: Certificate (X.509 mTLS) Authentication from the SDK
type: SDK-side client-certificate (mTLS) authentication - connecting with a certificate instead of a username/password, configured via a CertificateAuthenticator - distinct from sdk:tls-secure-connections (which secures the transport channel itself and can be used with either password or certificate authentication)
note: Recurs across concept-docs/certificate-based-authentication.json (this round's dedicated concept page), project-docs/migrating-sdk-code-to-3.n.json, ref/glossary.json, and howtos/sdk-authentication.json (a round-3/4 pre-gate file whose one relation here carries the link-boundary evidence artifact - see round 30's pre-gate finding).
